description: CALL THIS WHEN THE WORK IS ACTUALLY OVER — the last check made, the last fix verified, the answer about to be written. The mark on every driven tab the person is NOT looking at then pulses slowly, so somebody who walked away from the screen can see from across the room that it ended. It stops by itself when they look at that tab; there is nothing to dismiss. It is a nudge, not a report: still say what you did, in your own words. And it is not a progress beat — calling it between steps teaches people to ignore it, which costs the signal its only job. Any further call cancels it, so a run that continues quietly withdraws it. A short sound plays as well, for somebody who is not looking at the browser at all — the person can switch the sound off in the popup, and the pulse stays either way. Free, and it touches nothing on the page.

tabId.description: Target tab (from qa_tabs); omit for the active tab

verdict.description: How it ended. `ok` (default) rises; `problem` falls — the same sound in two directions, so the ear tells them apart without being taught. Say what you actually found; a run that discovered a defect ended FINE if you finished the work.

name: qa_done
title: Say the run has finished
